title: Playing in the Park
text:
Maria likes to play games with her friends. Her favourite game is hide and seek. One person closes their eyes and counts to ten. The others run and hide behind trees and cars.

Another game is jump rope. Maria and her friend Lucia turn the long rope while a girl jumps in the middle. They count each jump out loud. Maria says it is the best game of the day.

questions.text: What do Maria and Lucia do in the jump rope game?
What can we guess about the game of hide and seek?
options: It needs more than one player
It is played only in houses
It is played with a ball

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel about jump rope?

vocabulary.definition: people you like and spend time with
a long, thick string used to pull or jump

paragraph_translations: A María le gusta jugar juegos con sus amigos. Su juego favorito es las escondidas. Una persona cierra los ojos y cuenta hasta diez. Los demás corren y se esconden detrás de los árboles y los coches.
Otro juego es saltar la cuerda. María y su amiga Lucía giran la cuerda larga mientras una niña salta en el medio. Cuentan cada salto en voz alta. María dice que es el mejor juego del día.
